Chapter 6653: Vitality Condensed, I Am Immortal

Chapter 6653: Vitality Condensed, I Am Immortal

“Boom!” Space and beyond seemingly exploded. A blinding light swept through all worlds, preventing those in Three Immortals from opening their eyes. Even primal ancestors and heaven-slayer couldn’t see clearly.

Despite the distance, the shockwaves pushed Three Immortals away.

“Ahh!” Inhabitants screamed in horror after the impact.

The stars within the being exploded, releasing and channeling power toward its chest. It gained an incredible might and overwhelmed its foes.

If it wasn’t for an immortal formation protecting them, the legions would have turned to blood. Cracks appeared on the formation; the combatants, including the apex primal ancestors, vomited blood.

Once the light dispersed, everyone saw the cosmic avatar standing there. However, it wasn’t as silent as before. Its power was in full view now and swept through the boundless space.

Everyone realized why Life and Death Heaven had separated from the world. This saved them from being obliterated by the shockwaves.

It finally looked unstoppable, capable of inflicting devastating damage with each move. Its first sentence rang true, taking spectators’ breath away.

The starry radiance pulsing in its chest was the strongest in this world, more potent than countless stars.

“Desolate Ancestor’s immortal formation can’t be beaten...” Godstallion murmured.

If he were in charge of the legions for an assault on Life and Death Heaven again, he wouldn’t have much confidence in winning.

“It is meant to stop the three legions.” He added.

Previously, the two armies fought relatively evenly. However, Supreme Heaven had the advantage most of the time.

Now, Desolate Ancestor had trained her forces well enough to perform this immortal formation. The training took many years and ample effort.

“Desolate Ancestor is beyond our reach, we are mere fireflies in comparison.” Weizhen sighed and had nothing but respect and admiration for Desolate Ancestor.

“Use the immortal loop.” He ordered.

“We humbly summon the lord’s loop.” The three commanders summoned an item each.

Tunri had a blue loop, One Move had a golden one, and Six-headed had a white one. They respectfully raised the loop above their head.

“The lord’s evolution loops.” Godstallion’s expression changed: “First time for them.”

He heard of them before but Weizhen always kept them in Supreme Heaven. They were supposed to be ace cards, potentially for worst-case scenarios.

They suffered a devastating defeat during Heavenslay but didn’t take it out then. The commanders crushed the loops and particles fell upon them.

“Vitality condensed, I am immortal.” They chanted and gathered their dao, initiating a fusion between all legion members.

Once enough vitality and powers gathered, a majestic figure appeared. Of course, it wasn’t as big as the cosmic avatar.

However, immortal rays emanated from it, causing ripples to pulse outward. The figure held a sword made from the void. It devoured light instead of emitting it.

“The most recent lord.” Godstallion said.

“Poye...” Other primal ancestors took a deep breath.

This figure was none other than Poye, one of the most brilliant beings in Three Immortals. All geniuses compared themselves to him, the highest standard.
